owner_order: "Zrób test na całym zbiorze meczy" (2026-10-14): one more frozen test on the 172 held-out matches

arms.G: z_g_combo + dist@0 (natural cubic spline, 3 df) + angle@0 (wrapped to [0, pi], linear) + shot_missing@0 + ball_none@0; C by inner CV, z unpenalised
arms.GS: G + the SoccerNet flags with non-zero training variance (sn_direct_fk, sn_indirect_fk_3s, sn_corner_20s, sn_prev_shot_5s); descriptive, no success label

design.columns: the C6 protocol's design.arms.<arm>.columns; the test refuses any other column list

final_fit.rows: all 7,062 non-penalty training shots of the 328 training matches (results/xgd_a1_ensemble/oof.csv), z_g_combo their out-of-fold G-combo logit
final_fit.c_choice: match-grouped CV over the 5 host folds of cache/folds_xgv_home5.csv on the frozen grid {0.001, 0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1}: each fold's design preprocessed on the other four folds' rows only, every C fitted there and scored on the fold, the summed held-out log-loss picks C (ties: the smaller C); an edge value of the grid is accepted and recorded
final_fit.refit: imputation means, natural-spline knots (quantiles 0, 1/3, 2/3, 1) and standardisation fitted on all 7,062 training rows; the L2 logistic regression (Newton, xgpoc.stack.fit.logistic_fit) at the chosen C with z unpenalised
final_fit.zero_variance: the training rows' zero-variance list (xgpoc.stack.fit.spec on the training table)
final_fit.outcome: the index goal of the training shots, read inside the held-out label seal
final_fit.written: results/xgs_test_prep/final_fit.json: coefficients, chosen C, inner losses and every transform, before any test label is read

population.inclusion: every index v1.2 shot whose game has plan role evaluation or gate and whose is_penalty is false; no other exclusion; a shot that cannot be scored stops the test
population.label: index v1.2 goal

test_inputs.z: z = (logit(p) - b) / a, p the deployed G-combo probability of results/xgd_gcombo_test/predictions.csv and (a, b) the full-precision Platt of results/xgv_g_combo/ensemble.json; the prior correction is the identity (oof_rate = pooled_rate) and is refused otherwise
test_inputs.e3: cache/xgd_full3/E3 replayed with E3's ball-source rule (the replay must equal features.parquet exactly), the frozen sanitation, the angle wrap min(theta, 2 pi - theta) after the replay check with its count (xgpoc.stack.inputs.e3_table)
test_inputs.flags: SoccerNet Labels-v2.json of the 172 matches, 'Goal' dropped and both shot types made one kind at parse (xgpoc.stack.inputs.flags_table)
test_inputs.ball_source: a level never seen in training enters no model (the zero-variance list is the training rows'); it is counted and reported; a code outside E3's levels stops the build
test_inputs.predictions: results/xgs_test_prep/predictions.csv: z_g_combo, the deployed G-combo p, p_R, p_G, p_GS per test shot, written before any test label is read

metric.name: shot-weighted log-loss
metric.delta: LL(G) - LL(R), each the mean over the population's shots of -(y log p + (1 - y) log(1 - p))

bootstrap.unit: match (paired: one draw of matches weights both arms' shots)
bootstrap.implementation: xgpoc.detector.testrule.match_weights (A1's draws: readability.match_draw_counts over the sorted unique matches); replicate = sum(w d) / sum(w)

success.rule: the upper bound of the two-sided percentile interval of dLL at the success level in force is below 0; the level in force is 0.95 unless the synthetic-null gate moved it (before_scoring.level_in_force)

worse.rule: the lower bound of the same interval is above 0

equivalence.rule: the 90% percentile interval of dLL from the same draws lies wholly inside the open (-delta, +delta); delta = 0.002 sets the label, delta = 0.005 is reported beside it for comparability with A1
equivalence.status: descriptive; never a success; cannot rescue a failed success rule

label_precedence: the first that applies, in the order of labels; both equivalence flags are reported in every case

sentences.success and equivalent: Test na 172 meczach odłożonych wykazał poprawę: ΔLL(G − R) = {delta} [{lo}; {hi}] ({level}% przedział, górna granica poniżej 0). Zarazem 90% przedział [{lo90}; {hi90}] mieści się w ±{margin}, więc poprawa jest mniejsza niż margines równoważności.
sentences.success: Test na 172 meczach odłożonych wykazał poprawę: ΔLL(G − R) = {delta} [{lo}; {hi}] ({level}% przedział, górna granica poniżej 0).
sentences.worse: Test na 172 meczach odłożonych wykazał pogorszenie: ΔLL(G − R) = {delta} [{lo}; {hi}] ({level}% przedział, dolna granica powyżej 0). Geometria E3 w stackerze szkodzi na meczach odłożonych.
sentences.equivalent within δ: Test na 172 meczach odłożonych nie wykazał poprawy ani pogorszenia: ΔLL(G − R) = {delta} [{lo}; {hi}] ({level}% przedział). 90% przedział [{lo90}; {hi90}] mieści się w ±{margin}, więc G i R są równoważne w granicy δ = {margin} (TOST, odczyt opisowy).
sentences.inconclusive: Test na 172 meczach odłożonych nie wykazał poprawy ani pogorszenia: ΔLL(G − R) = {delta} [{lo}; {hi}] ({level}% przedział). 90% przedział [{lo90}; {hi90}] nie mieści się w ±{margin}: wynik nierozstrzygnięty (najmniejszy margines równoważności {smallest}).

practical_clauses.below_bar: Punkt {delta} jest powyżej progu praktycznego −0.002: poprawa jest wykrywalna, ale poniżej progu praktycznego.

descriptive.status: never a success, never rescues the primary reading, nothing feeds the headline; every item labelled 'hypothesis formed on these matches'
descriptive.GS_vs_R: dLL(GS - R) with the same draws and intervals; no success label
descriptive.G_vs_g_combo: dLL(G - deployed G-combo) with the same draws; also R - deployed G-combo
descriptive.scores: log-loss, AUC, Brier, mean p, calibration slope and intercept (logit(p) regressed with C = 1e6) of R, G, GS and the deployed G-combo
descriptive.by_role: dLL(G - R) restricted to the evaluation shots (3,005) and to the gate shots (814): the same 5,000 draws, each replicate the weighted mean over the role's shots
descriptive.categories: O, E, O/E per arm (R, G, GS) and dLL against R with its 95% interval from the same draws restricted to the category's shots, in the development's categories (xgpoc.stack.stats.CATEGORIES): E3 shot_x@0 < 88.5 (outside the box), E3 angle@0 < 15 degrees, E3 dist@0 < 6 m, sn_corner_20s = 1, sn_direct_fk = 1; a shot whose defining input is missing is outside the category's population

statsbomb.when: once, after results/xgs_test/complete.json exists (scripts/xgs_test_statsbomb.py refuses otherwise)
statsbomb.population: the primary shots of xg-compare's table results/xgc_compare/table (in_primary: 2,721 paired non-penalty shots of the 135 evaluation matches), joined one to one with the test predictions
statsbomb.spearman: Spearman's rho of p_R, p_G and the deployed G-combo p with the vendor's xG (p_vendor)

categories.sb_dist_lt_6yd: sb_dist < 6 yd to the goal centre; kept apart from the E3 dist < 6 m category

statsbomb.per_category: per model (R, G, G-combo), over the shots where the category is defined: n in and out, mean p of the model and the vendor in, the gap in xG points 100 (mean p_model - mean p_vendor) in and out, and the unadjusted contrast of the logit gap mean(logit p_model - logit p_vendor | in) - mean(... | out); the models' own probabilities, not xg-compare's cross-fitted main scale
statsbomb.label: hypothesis formed on these matches; Data: StatsBomb.
statsbomb.never: an input, target, selection or check of any model; read before the test result

checks.z_inversion: max |Platt(z) - p| <= 1e-12 over the 3,819 shots; max |z - member z| <= 1e-6 where member logits are stored (gate shots' stored predictions, unpaired evaluation shots' unpaired_members.csv), member z the mean over the ten members of logit(sigmoid(logit / T)); no p at the clip 1e-6; the paired shots' p were checked against their members in ticket 06 (results/xgd_gcombo_test/checks.json). Stop on any failure
checks.z_distribution: the test z's mean and SD (ddof 1) over the 7,062 training out-of-fold z's: stop when either ratio is outside [0.8, 1.25]
checks.coverage: 3,819 shots, 172 matches (135 evaluation, 37 gate; 3,005 and 814 shots), unique shot ids, every shot with its G-combo probability (one to one), E3 row and flags, finite z, predictions inside (0, 1). Stop on any failure
checks.provenance: no test shot or match is a training shot or match; every test shot is of an evaluation or gate match; the arms' columns equal the C6 protocol's and carry no banned name; the flags do not change when 'Goal' annotations are added and shot types swapped; every read runs inside the label seal and with no StatsBomb or xg-compare path. Stop on any failure
checks.ball_source: t0 level counts in test and training, the levels unseen in training (reported, not a stop)
checks.angle_wrap: the count of test shots per offset whose angle the wrap changed (reported)
checks.e3_replay: the replayed E3 features equal the cache exactly (stop otherwise)

gate.name: synthetic-null false-success check on the written test predictions (council C7 Q5, member S), labels unread
gate.truth: y* ~ Bernoulli(sigmoid(logit(p_R) + u_m)), u_m ~ N(0, 0.25^2) a match random intercept drawn per replicate before the outcomes (C6's clustered nulls' SD)
gate.statistic: dLL(G - R) on y* with the test's own 5,000 draws (seed 0); a false success at level L is an upper bound of the L interval below 0
gate.ladder: if the rate at 0.95 exceeds 0.05, the success level moves to the first of 0.975, 0.99, 0.995 whose rate is <= 0.05; if none is, the test does not run and the question returns to the council
gate.written: results/xgs_test_prep/gate.json, and the level in force in before_scoring, before any test label is read

power.status: planning figures, normal approximation (xgpoc.detector.testrule.expected_power), computed before scoring with no test label

standard_errors.dev_sd_shot_scaled: the development bootstrap SD of G's dLL (results/xgs_stack/real/summary.json, 2,000 draws) x sqrt(7,062 / 3,819) (headline)

effects.practical_recovered: -0.002 x C6's recovery (control 4: G's mean recovered dLL over the planted -0.002)

power.readings: P(success) and P(worse) at every success level, P(equivalent) at delta 0.002 and 0.005; the headline is P(success) at the development point with the shot-scaled SE at the level in force

disclosures: The 172 held-out matches are now spent for detector-input variants: this is their second labelled look for a detector variant (the first was A1, ticket 07 of xg-detector); no further detector-input variant may be tested on them.
The owner lifted the one-test rule for this test only (2026-10-14).
E3's configuration was chosen on 135 of the 172 matches by StatsBomb position error, with no outcomes.
The xg-compare phase looked at these matches' outcomes (exploratory); it motivated the inputs and partly the flag windows.
The 135 evaluation matches' labels were seen in xg-vendor; the 37 gate matches were scored by G-combo in xg-vendor's retraining gate.

The test z averages the ten G-combo members (each test shot is held out by all ten), the training z the two members that held each training shot out; the scale shift is what the z-distribution check bounds.
z_g_combo is the averaged pre-Platt logit; each member's epoch and temperature were chosen on its own scored fold, an outcome-dependent step (C6's corrected disclosure 3).
Stacking provenance: the training z values come from models fitted on the other training folds; the final fit uses all 7,062 training shots, so its estimation cost is below the development's.
The flags are research-only (a product needs an action spotter); GS is descriptive.
A success near the development point (about -0.0006) is below the practical bar -0.002 and must be reported as such.
The match bootstrap resamples matches for fixed fitted models; it does not capture the final fit's own variability.
scope: The result applies to the C6 stacker over the frozen G-combo with E3 geometry as audited in pitch-keypoints, not to detector-derived structure in general.
rerun: only after a purely technical failure, with the same inputs, written down in ticket 04
